meta.title: feat(dashboard): add improved app filtering with bundle ID support
meta.body_summary: Add dashboard search/filter for apps with bundle ID prefix syntax, lazy MAU loading, and adjusted debounce timing for large datasets.

perf_labels.notes: Devin PR with narrative performance claims; zero formal reviews, only bot comments, closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 77 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. As a small-step performance PR it was closed without merge—no human review or maintainer engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or human feedback in dataset. Two bot comments (Devin intro, CodeRabbit skip) but no maintainer interaction.
review_details.performance_claim: Multi-term AND search with bundle:id: prefix, lazy MAU loading, and 800ms debounce improve filtering performance for large app lists.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by riderx without comment; no review engagement indicates PR was not accepted.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Frontend performance tweak with narrative claims but no benchmark; without maintainer review or performance validation, the PR was closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: In AppTable.vue, refactored search logic to split terms and apply AND filtering with bundle/id: prefix, moved MAU fetching to a cached lazy-load for filtered apps, and increased debounce from 500ms to 800ms.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Minor changes in Table.vue and Dashboard.vue (2-3 lines each) likely to support the new filter prop or debounce wiring.
change_trajectory: Single commit (de70cf6c) containing all changes: search algorithm enhancement, MAU caching/loading optimization, and debounce adjustment.
